evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Joanna: 'just need about ten to fifteen minutes to discuss that call if this is a good time?' — framing present (time-boxed, promise implicit) but does not wait for explicit yes; Gina says 'Yes, that's fine' which could count as yes, but it's thin and not a deliberate pause.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Joanna: 'aside from the pricing, do you have any important concerns for this move that you also want to discuss on this call?' Asked before any probing. Gina: 'No.' — no concerns raised, so Two Layers Deep and Active Listening Reflection both N/A.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name: Gina McCauley (implied from greeting); moving day: October 12, flexible; route: Dallas to Austin; size: one-bedroom apartment. All four asked.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type: apartment; floors: current 7th floor (initial misstatement corrected), new 4th floor; rooms: 1 bed, 1 living room; elevators: yes both ends; walking distance from parking: ~50 feet current, unknown new; distance door to elevator: <6 feet current. Furniture: bed, dresser, nightstand, couch, coffee table, miniature freezer, stand-up desk, lightweight TV, bookshelves on rollers. Boxes: ~30 plastic moving tubs. Nearly all seven items covered.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Joanna gives hourly rate ($204/hr for 2 men and truck) and lists inclusions (wraps, assembly, taxes, insurance, credit fees), plus travel fee ($1,056) and potential overnight fee ($240). Personalizes minimally to Monday rate and notes timing affects overnight fee applicability — partial, not fully personalized to Gina's specific prep or concerns (no concerns were raised).
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Fee transparency: travel fee and overnight fee disclosed. Commitment framing: mentions 'charge by the hour' twice and that hourly includes multiple items, but does NOT mention 2.5-hour minimum or 15-minute-increment billing or 'not a guess' framing. Partial.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Never asked. Gina interrupts with a clarifying question about travel fee structure; Joanna answers but never circles back to 'Does that feel fair?' and never holds silence.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No loop closure attempted on the Two Promises section.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Call ends abruptly when Gina decides to seek cheaper alternatives (renting a truck herself).
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' or equivalent. Gina volunteers to explore alternatives and ends the call; Joanna says 'thank you so much for considering us' but never asks for the business.

top_strength: Joanna gathered comprehensive logistics details efficiently — floor levels, walking distances, furniture inventory, box count, elevator access — building a solid foundation for an accurate estimate.
coaching_note: The call collapsed after pricing because Joanna never delivered the Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage), never asked 'Does that feel fair?' to lock confidence, and never made an explicit ask for the business — once Gina voiced sticker shock and pivoted to a DIY truck rental, there was no safety net to keep her engaged.
